name: urlund/wordpress-updater
description: WordPress plugin and theme updater with GitHub integration and CLI release tools

scripts-descriptions.wp-json: Generate release.json from plugin or theme headers
scripts-descriptions.wp-zip: Package plugin/theme files into a ZIP archive
scripts-descriptions.wp-publish: Publish ZIP and release.json to GitHub
scripts-descriptions.wp-release: Bump, zip, generate release.json, and optionally publish
